text:
morgan: Quick design check — pin in the compare rows feels really easy to miss once the row collapses. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-catalog-pin-v1 :eyes:

jess: I noticed that too. When the row collapses the performance badges disappear and users lose context about which version is pinned.

kai: Could we move the pin to the far left so it's still visible in collapsed state? Or show a tiny persisted dot next to the model name.

isabella: +1 to left edge. Also make sure it's keyboard focusable and has aria-label="Pin model for compare" so screen readers know what it does.

morgan: Quick list of options I sketched: 1) persistent pin icon that stays visible on collapse 2) compact sticky header that shows pinned versions 3) pin-on-hover only (hide otherwise). My vote: 1 or 2.

jess: Leaning 2 (sticky header) — it keeps rows cleaner and centralizes pinned items for multi-model compares.

kai: Sticky header is nice but eats vertical space on dense tables. Suggest a hybrid: sticky header for >3 pinned, otherwise persistent inline pin.

isabella: Accessibility nits: current performance badge color (light green) fails contrast at small sizes. We should increase saturation or add a 1px outline plus text label on hover. Also ensure badges have aria-describedby linking to tooltip content.

morgan: Also microcopy: tooltip currently says 'Pin version' — I'd prefer 'Pin model for compare' which reads clearer for product people.

jess: For keyboard toggles, implement aria-pressed and accept space/enter. Example snippet:

```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pin model for compare">📌</button>
```

kai: UX detail: when a model is pinned, filters should optionally snap to show that model (or there should be a quick 'show pinned' action) so users don't lose the pinned row after applying filters.

isabella: Microcopy tweak: change the performance badge tooltip title to 'Latency / Cost' and break out numbers on hover. That helps PMs understand tradeoffs quickly.

morgan: I'll prototype the persistent pin + compact header experiment tomorrow morning and share a short demo. Can someone add the a11y tasks to the board? @product-ops

ui-bot: Created task INV-3245: "Compare pin visibility + a11y improvements" and attached Figma frames.

jess: awesome, thanks! :thumbsup:

morgan: Locking on option 1 (persistent inline pin) with follow-up header experiment. Will demo Friday during design review.
